input.subject: NOW ACCEPTING RESERVATIONS | Harlem's newest condominium | Closings 2027
input.bodyText:
Brokers,

The Lenox at 275 Lenox Ave, Harlem is now accepting reservations ahead of our formal sales launch. Reservation agreements come with a fully refundable deposit and lock in priority unit selection.

The building is not yet on the market for contract — estimated first closings in Q3 2027. 68 condominium residences, studios to 3BR. Reserve your buyers now to secure early access and pricing.

2.5% co-broke honored for reserved buyers who close.

Marcus Bell
The Lenox Sales Team
